title: Northgate Delivery & Installation: Members Holding Several Appointments
content:
A member may hold any number of Northgate Delivery & Installation appointments; Northgate sets no limit per member. One purchase may have several appointments when its merchandise needs different service levels — for example a refrigerator on an installation appointment and a sofa on a white glove appointment.

## Each appointment stands on its own

Each appointment carries its own fees, credits and claims. A credit or a claim on one appointment is never applied to another appointment, even when both appointments deliver merchandise from the same purchase.

| Question | Answer under this rule |
|---|---|
| Is there a cap on how many appointments one member holds? | No. Any number may be held. |
| Can one purchase be split across appointments? | Yes, when its merchandise needs different service levels. |
| Where does a fee, credit or claim belong? | On the appointment it was raised on, and only there. |
| Can a credit earned on one appointment reduce a fee on another appointment of the same purchase? | No. |

## Hypothetical illustration

A member's purchase includes a refrigerator and a sofa. The refrigerator travels on a Northgate Appliance Delivery & Installation appointment and the sofa on a Northgate White Glove Delivery appointment. A credit posted on the sofa appointment stays on the sofa appointment; a claim raised about the refrigerator appointment is a claim on that appointment alone.
